description: This file implements a worker for processing recap jobs in the Mattermost server, including job creation, execution, progress tracking, and updating recap status with WebSocket notifications.

classes.name: AppIface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for processing recap channels and publishing WebSocket events.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleWorker for recap jobs, enabling or disabling based on feature flags.

methods.name: processRecapJob
methods.description: Main function to process a recap job, updating statuses, handling success/failure, and notifying via WebSocket.

methods.name: publishRecapUpdate
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket event to notify clients about recap updates.
